sidebar.title: Nivetha Sathiyapal
sidebar.subtitle: AI, Data & Digital Solutions Consultant
sidebar.description:
I build full-stack digital solutions for small-business use cases, including bakery e-commerce, restaurant reservations, salon booking systems, admin dashboards, lead-generation tools, and AI-assisted automation workflows.

Based in Bolzano, Italy, and open to full-time, consulting, and project-based collaboration.

about.title: About
about.description:
I help cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and small local businesses in Bolzano build simple, mobile-friendly digital tools that make it easier for customers to browse, contact, order, book, or reserve.

My focus is on practical solutions that small businesses can actually use clean websites, digital menus, WhatsApp ordering flows, booking forms, and simple admin dashboards.

Whether you need a professional online presence or a small system to manage enquiries, orders, or bookings, I build solutions that are easy for customers to use and easy for business owners to manage.

whatIBuild.title: Business Websites
whatIBuild.description: Mobile-first websites for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and local service businesses. Designed to look professional, load fast, and help customers quickly understand what you offer.

whatIBuild.title: Digital Menus & Product Catalogues
whatIBuild.description: Online menus and product catalogues that customers can browse from their phone. Ideal for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, home bakers, salons, and small retail businesses.

whatIBuild.title: WhatsApp Ordering & Enquiry Flows
whatIBuild.description: Simple order and enquiry flows that guide customers from browsing to contacting you directly through WhatsApp, phone, or a contact form.

whatIBuild.title: Booking & Reservation Tools
whatIBuild.description: Online booking and reservation flows for salons, studios, restaurants, and service-based businesses. Customers can request a time, and you receive the booking details clearly.

whatIBuild.title: Admin Dashboards
whatIBuild.description: Simple private dashboards to manage products, menu items, enquiries, bookings, and basic business updates without needing technical knowledge.

whyItWorks.title: Built for Mobile
whyItWorks.description: Most customers search, browse, and contact businesses from their phones. Every website and tool is designed mobile-first so customers can take action quickly.

whyItWorks.title: Easy for Customers
whyItWorks.description: Clear navigation, simple product or service pages, visible contact buttons, and direct WhatsApp flows make it easier for visitors to become customers.

whyItWorks.title: Simple for Business Owners
whyItWorks.description: The goal is not to create complicated software. The goal is to give you tools that are easy to update, manage, and use in your daily business.

whyItWorks.title: Local Business Focus
whyItWorks.description: Built for the needs of small businesses in Bolzano and nearby areas cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, home businesses, and local services.

whyItWorks.title: Multilingual Ready
whyItWorks.description: Websites can be structured for English, Italian, and German content, helping local and tourist customers understand your services more easily.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A selection of digital solution projects I have designed and developed for small-business use cases, including bakery ordering, restaurant reservations, salon booking, admin dashboards, and customer enquiry flows.

projects.title: The Little Patisserie — Artisan Bakery E-Commerce
projects.description: A full-stack bakery e-commerce platform for a boutique home bakery, featuring a dynamic menu, cart flow, custom cake orders, Razorpay payment integration, delivery options, WhatsApp notifications, and an admin dashboard for order and menu management.
features: Dynamic bakery menu with categories, best sellers, new launches, and product badges
Shopping cart with quantity, pricing, and eggless/egg-based options
Pickup, local delivery, and courier delivery flows
Custom cake enquiry flow with flavour, size, occasion, message, and design options
Razorpay payment integration
Order status tracking with WhatsApp notification workflow
Password-protected admin panel for orders, menu items, gallery, and store status
Responsive bakery-focused design with smooth UI animations
projects.techStack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Razorpay, Framer Motion, Lucide React, Sentry, Render

projects.title: Ristorante Bella Vita — Restaurant Website & Reservation System
projects.description: A complete restaurant website with online reservations, live availability checking, email confirmations, bilingual English/German support, and a secure admin panel for managing reservations, menu items, and customer messages.
features: Public website with home, about, menu, reservations, gallery, and contact pages
Online reservation flow with live time-slot availability
Email confirmation workflow
Secure admin panel with JWT authentication
Reservation, menu, and message management
English/German bilingual support
Responsive design with Framer Motion animations
Rate-limited APIs, input sanitization, and security headers
projects.techStack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, JWT, bcryptjs, Nodemailer, Framer Motion

projects.title: Bellezza Salon — Booking Website & Admin Platform
projects.description: A full-stack salon website and booking platform with trilingual content, online appointment booking, service catalogue, staff assignment, and an admin dashboard for managing bookings, services, reviews, FAQs, and staff.
features: Public marketing website with hero, services, team, reviews, FAQ, and contact sections
Online booking flow with multi-service selection, date/time picking, and staff assignment
Admin dashboard for services, bookings, calendar, staff, reviews, and FAQs
Trilingual support for Italian, English, and German
SEO-ready setup with Schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, sitemap, robots.txt, and PWA manifest
Responsive design using Tailwind CSS v4
PostgreSQL-backed data model with Prisma ORM
projects.techStack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Prisma 7, Neon PostgreSQL, Vercel

services.title: Services
